scope: Replay archive download, GT2 message encoding, GHTTP request lifecycle, replay metadata serialization, and match setup construction

applied.name: ReplayMatchSetup_Ctor
applied.evidence: Constructs the 0xD0-byte replay match/setup object, initializes its owned strings and embedded collection, then calls the already recovered ReplayMatchSetup_Reset.
applied.basis: exact-build constructor call sites and field offsets

applied.name: KWReplayHeader_FreeMetadataBuffer
applied.evidence: Frees and nulls the replay header's optional owned metadata pointer at offset 0xADC.

applied.name: KWReplayNetworkSendBuffer_CommitEncodedMessage
applied.evidence: Writes the encoded message length as a network-order 16-bit prefix at data+used and advances used by payload length plus two.
applied.basis: all six replay network writer call sites and buffer invariants

applied.name: KWReplayProtocol_AppendIntegerKeyValue
applied.evidence: Appends a NUL-terminated key followed by its NUL-terminated decimal integer value, returning bytes written or -1 on insufficient space.

applied.name: gtInternalEncodeV
applied.evidence: GameSpy GT2 internal variadic message encoder, including the optional 16-bit message type and packed 'z' bit fields.

applied.name: gtEncodeV
applied.evidence: GameSpy GT2 typed-message va_list encoder wrapper.

applied.name: gtEncode
applied.evidence: GameSpy GT2 variadic typed-message encoder wrapper.

applied.name: ghiProcessConnection
applied.evidence: Runs one GameSpy GHTTP connection state-machine step, dispatches completion, closes the file/socket, and frees completed connections.
applied.basis: control-flow and field-for-source match to GameSpy ghttpMain.c

applied.name: ghttpStartup
applied.evidence: Reference-counted GameSpy GHTTP SDK initialization.

applied.name: ghttpCleanup
applied.evidence: Reference-counted GameSpy GHTTP SDK teardown.

applied.name: _ghttpGetEx
applied.evidence: Internal GameSpy GHTTP extended GET constructor and optional blocking processing loop.
applied.basis: control-flow and field-for-source match to GameSpy ghttpMain.c

applied.name: _ghttpSaveEx
applied.evidence: Internal GameSpy GHTTP save-to-file request constructor used by the replay archive downloader.
applied.basis: control-flow and field-for-source match to GameSpy ghttpMain.c

applied.name: ghttpSaveExA
applied.evidence: ANSI GameSpy GHTTP extended save wrapper; converts the filename to UCS-2 for the Unicode build.

applied.name: ghttpSaveExW
applied.evidence: Unicode GameSpy GHTTP extended save wrapper used to download replay archives into archiveN.KWReplay.
applied.basis: instruction-for-source match to GameSpy ghttpMain.c and replay caller

applied.name: _ghttpStreamEx
applied.evidence: Internal GameSpy GHTTP extended streaming request constructor.
applied.basis: control-flow and field-for-source match to GameSpy ghttpMain.c

applied.name: _ghttpHeadEx
applied.evidence: Internal GameSpy GHTTP extended HEAD request constructor.
applied.basis: control-flow and field-for-source match to GameSpy ghttpMain.c

applied.name: ghttpRequestThink
applied.evidence: Resolves a GHTTP request handle and processes one state-machine step.

applied.name: ghttpCancelRequest
applied.evidence: Resolves and frees an active GHTTP request.

applied.name: ghttpGetHeaders
applied.evidence: Returns the received-header pointer once the connection has reached the header state and the stored index is in bounds.

applied.name: ghttpSetThrottle
applied.evidence: Changes the throttle flag for an active GHTTP request and updates the live socket option when connected.

applied.name: UCS2ToAsciiString
applied.evidence: Converts a NUL-terminated UCS-2 string to an 8-bit string by copying the low byte of each code unit.

applied.name: ghiFreeConnection
applied.evidence: Frees all owned GHTTP connection strings/buffers, closes file and socket resources, releases post/encryption state, and frees its slot.

applied.name: ghiRequestToConnection
applied.evidence: Validates a GHTTP request index and returns its in-use connection.

applied.name: ghiNewConnection
applied.evidence: Allocates and initializes a 0x1C0-byte GHTTP connection plus its five embedded 0x24-byte buffers.
applied.basis: field-for-source match to GameSpy ghttpConnection.c and allocation size
